messages:
maria: quick heads-up — forecast for the Q4 APAC promo shows a sharp late-night spike (00:00–03:00 SGT) next Tue: ~4x baseline QPS. We need a short runway plan for GPUs + network.

raj: thanks — can you drop the hour-by-hour? i ran a quick sim and the tail is tight. rough GPU-hours: baseline 120 GPUh/day -> extra burst ~180 GPUh during 3h window (so +60 GPUh for that window).

maria: attaching the simulator output (summary):
```
window 00-01: +1.2x
window 01-02: +3.8x
window 02-03: +4.1x
peak minute (01:47): 4.6x
estimated extra GPUh: 60
cache-warm penalty: ~8% latency uplift if not prefetched
```

oliver: we should prewarm a small pool of Nv86s in ap-southeast1 and ap-northeast1 90m before window. autoscaler policy needs lower cooldown for burst (current cooldown 10m -> 2m). also enable prefix cache warmstart for top 20 prefixes.

hana: FYI network quotas in ap-southeast1 are stricter overnight because of GC backups; egress caps might kick in if we double traffic. We'll need to validate egress and NAT gateway SNAT ports. pinging infra-nat-team.

raj: cost hedge idea: use a mix — reserve a tiny guaranteed pool (4 GPUs) + spot-backed prewarm to avoid sudden cold starts. math: 
```
reserved 4 * 3h = 12 GPUh (guaranteed)
spot prewarm 10 * 3h = 30 GPUh (cheaper but preemptible)
on-prewarm on-demand for overflow ~18 GPUh
```

maria: +1 on the hybrid approach. can we keep the reserved pool in the cheapest region that still meets latency SLO? maybe ap-northeast1 for lower latency to JP users, ap-southeast1 for SEA. open to suggestions.

oliver: ap-northeast1 has slightly higher instance startup time (image pull hotspots). ap-southeast1 has NAT limits (hana mentioned). proposing: reserved in ap-northeast1 (4 GPUs), prewarm spot in ap-southeast1 and failover routing if egress errs.

hana: I asked infra-nat-team to raise SNAT port quota by 25% for the blast window. they said provisional OK if we commit the time. also checking whether our loadbalancer connection limit needs bump.

maria: decision call for ops: 1) reserve 4 GPUs in ap-northeast1 from 23:00–04:00 SGT next Tue; 2) spot prewarm in ap-southeast1 90m before; 3) reduce autoscaler cooldown to 2m for the window; 4) enable prefix warmstart for top 20 prefixes. can we get thumbs by EOD? :thumbsup: :thinking_face:

raj: thumbs. I'll create the infra PR with the instance types + cost estimate (will include breakouts for reserved vs spot).

oliver: I'll add the autoscaler patch and the cache warmstart job. patch will be: 
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"coolDownSeconds":120}}'
```

hana: quota request approved for SNAT ports +10% for that day. still waiting on LB conn increase.

sre-bot: snapshot: gpu-pool-ap-northeast1 utilization 72% (last 24h), recent evictions: 0, avg startup 75s.

maria: great — i'll schedule a 20m dry run tomorrow 22:30 SGT to validate prewarm and egress. if all good, proceed with planned runway next Tue. thanks all!

raj: will post PR link and cost numbers in the dry-run thread.

oliver: tagging runbook owners — please be on standby during the window.

hana: will monitor quotas and LB. ping me if you see 502s.
